## Problem Statement

## Desired Outcome

A clear outline of what you are trying to achieve.

## Success Criteria

* Use clear points for what the success criteria looks like
* This can be quantitative or qualitative
* Or a combination

## Impact

Explain the impact of the solution, what it could provide.

## Constraints

Outline the potential constraints and issues that may arise during this ask.

## Data Requirements

Express clearly what requirements you have for the data you will be using and if there are any potential issues with it.
